name: Device Name
no_usb_device_tip: The USB device will automatically appear here after being inserted into a host of a cluster that supports USB pass-through.
no_usb_device_tip2: The USB device will automatically appear here after being inserted into the host.
mount_usb_device_major: Mount the USB device {usb} on the host {host} to VM.
mount_usb_device_desc: Only VMs that belong to the host and are running or powered off can mount USB devices.
vm_to_mount_usb: Please select the VM to mount the USB device.
unmount_usb_device_major1: The USB device <0>{usb}</0> has been unplugged from the host. Are you sure to unmount it from the VM <1>{vm}</1>?
unmount_usb_device_desc1: After unmounting, the device will disappear from the USB device list.
unmount_usb_device_major2: Are you sure to unmount the USB device <0>{usb}</0> from the VM <1>{vm}</1>?
unmount_usb_device_desc2: Unmounting is equivalent to unplugging the device directly from the VM. Please make sure that there are no read or write operations on the USB device inside the VM.
